baseLayers.name: base-wide
baseLayers.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Production transparent PNG BASE LAYER for an ANIMATABLE Game Boy Advance emulator skin.
Input is the approved VIOLET/INDIGO full-screen design. LOCK the EXACT violet plastic hue and gentle neutral lighting of this reference for every edition. Flat orthographic view. Continuous violet plastic fills all four outer edges and corners; no device silhouette, no exterior background or transparency, no rounded outside contour.
IMPORTANT LAYER SEPARATION: render NO physical movable buttons whatsoever. The D-pad, A, B, SELECT, START, L and R must all be ABSENT. At their positions render genuinely TRANSPARENT CUTOUT HOLES in the panel, with narrow dark recessed sockets ONLY AROUND the perimeter of each hole. Interior of each socket must be alpha=0, completely empty. D-pad hole is a clean plus-shaped cross. A and B holes are perfectly circular. SELECT/START/L/R holes are horizontal rounded capsules. NO gray buttons left, NO arrow graphics, NO A/B/L/R labels floating inside holes. Labels belong to separate button PNG layers. Keep tiny SELECT/START captions beside the corresponding sockets if needed, never inside transparent areas.
Central game window also true alpha=0 throughout, exact rectangle 3:2, no glass or reflections, no specks, no opaque black fill or checkerboard. Screen black bezel and modest GAME BOY ADVANCE silver lettering remain outside window. Small green power LED and dark inset speaker slots stay ON THE BASE as fixed decorative features.
The PNG should have exactly EIGHT separate transparent holes: screen, cross, A, B, SELECT, START, L, R. Opaque plastic everywhere else. Match premium restrained realistic plastic material and gray-black beveled sockets of reference. No UI or mockup annotations.
WIDE iPhone LANDSCAPE edition. Aspect ratio 19.5:9. Preserve the approved image's composition and proportions, only replace its controls with cutout holes. Whole outermost 8% left AND 8% right remain uninterrupted purple to protect camera/encoche/Dynamic Island in both rotations. Keep bottommost 7% and topmost 5% as blank decorative purple. All control sockets entirely inside those safe margins. Screen is centered as in reference. D-pad cross hole left centered around (16%,46%); shoulder L hole (16%,18%); SELECT and START holes (13.3%,73%) and (20%,73%). A hole around (87%,43%), B around (81%,52%); R hole (84.5%,18%). Keep layout extremely faithful to supplied approved reference and color identical.

masterReference:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Production PNG emulator overlay for ultra-wide iPhone landscape, aspect 19.5:9.
INPUT 1 is the full-screen fascia design to revise. INPUT 2 is Nintendo's ORIGINAL OFFICIAL VIOLET/INDIGO hardware photograph: use it as the authoritative COLOR reference. Match that original slightly muted violet-purple plastic hue, not the electric royal blue of input 1. Keep gray buttons and charcoal screen frame.
Rebuild the control layout with TRUE CAMERA SAFE MARGINS. Entire leftmost 8% and rightmost 8% of the canvas must be ONLY UNINTERRUPTED PURPLE PLASTIC: no buttons, letters, bevels, frames or functional elements in these two strips. These quiet strips reserve the camera/encoche/Dynamic Island space in both landscape rotations. Reserve bottommost 7% and topmost 5% as plain purple too. Do not depict the actual phone camera, safe-area guides, notch or home indicator.
Move and reduce all controls to sit entirely WITHIN the safe interior. Left control column only x=8.5%..21%; right control column only x=79%..91.5%. D-pad centered x=14.7% y=46%, width 11.8% of canvas; its complete silhouette must stay inside x=8.5%..21%. L and R pads each 11.5% canvas wide, centers x=14.7% /85.3%, y=13%. Small SELECT START side by side under D-pad at y=78%, both fit in the left safe column. A and B gray circular buttons each 5.3% canvas wide, A center x=88.4% y=41%, B center x=82.5% y=55%. Small power light and speaker grille fit within right safe column, speaker ends above y=88%. All lettering small and sober.
Centered game aperture: exact 3:2 width-to-height, normalized x=23%, y=11%, width=54%, height=78% on the 19.5:9 canvas. Thin charcoal bezel OUTSIDE, with tiny GAME BOY ADVANCE inscription on lower bezel. The game aperture is absolutely transparent alpha=0 from edge to edge with sharp rectangular inner corners, NO tinted glass, reflections, specks, checkerboard or screenshot. This is the ONLY transparent region.
Purple plastic fills every outer canvas edge and corner, no external console contour, no external rounded edges, no outer transparency, no perspective. High-quality realistic restrained industrial design, soft neutral lighting. Recompose and re-render, do not crop or stretch. Final image must clearly show the generous plain violet margin at BOTH outer sides.
